fast.why: Today is Friday (Jumaat). Next sunnah fast is Monday 9 Nov. The Prophet ﷺ fasted Mondays and Thursdays.

blessing: The gift of dua itself: you can raise your hands to Allah anytime, even in a hard shift. After one solat today, ask Him for one need with hope.

verse.text: Your Lord has proclaimed, "Call upon Me, I will respond to you."

hadith.text: Supplication (du'a') is itself the worship. (He then recited:) "And your Lord said: Call on Me, I will answer you" (40:60).

lesson.title: Daily duas with meaning part 3: after every solat
lesson.text: Dua is not an extra after worship; it is worship (Abi Dawud 1479, Sahih). After each fardh, before you rush on, sit even thirty seconds and ask. A short Prophetic comprehensive dua asks Allah for all good in this life and the next, what you know and what you don't, and that every decree for you be good. He promised response (40:60); delay is not denial. At work, a quiet ask between cases still counts.

quote.text: Trust the Almighty's timing. Only He knows why you're in the state you are for so long. Perhaps the delay in answering your prayer is better for you than getting what you want now. He is the Best Planner.

videos.title: Omar Suleiman: The Most Comprehensive Du'a Ever Narrated
Ustaz Jafri Abu Bakar: Jangan Tinggal 3 Doa Ini Setiap Hari (Malay)

name.text: He answers the one who calls. Your quiet ask after solat is heard. Keep calling even when the answer is delayed; response comes in the form He chooses.
"I am truly near. I respond to one's prayer when they call upon Me." You do not need a perfect setting; He is closer than the stress of the day.

quote.text: Almighty. Grant us hearts filled with gratitude. May we count our blessings instead of our problems. We ask You for strength in times of need, peace in chaos, joy in sadness and hope in hopelessness. We know You won't disappoint. Aameen.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
